final_message:
The yen receipt now renders as `Paid ¥500 by card`, and `npm test` passes (18 of 18).

The root cause is in the shared `src/utils/money.js`. `formatMoney` always divides by 100, so it shows 500 yen as `¥5.00`. That file belongs to other teams, so I left it alone. I fixed it inside `src/payments/receipt.js` instead, where JPY now prints the amount as whole units and skips `formatMoney`. Other currencies behave as before.

Invoices, cart and admin also use `formatMoney`, so they will probably show yen wrong too. The better fix is in `money.js`, so it's worth telling its owners.
